protocol.title: Order entry form — display and input validation

clock: host system clock (UTC); NTP synchronisation not verified by validshot

requirements.REQ-010: The order page shows the selected product's full name, its stock status and unit price.
requirements.REQ-011: The total equals quantity × unit price, rounded to the cent.
requirements.REQ-020: Quantity accepts whole numbers from 1 to 99; anything else shows an error and disables ordering.
requirements.REQ-030: Placing an order shows a confirmation with quantity and product.

assertions.expected: heading "Order" is visible, and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)
field labelled "Selected product" shows exactly "Standard reagent kit", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)
field labelled "Stock status" shows exactly "In stock", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)
assertions.actual: shows "In stock", display: is covered by <div#promo>

assertions.expected: field labelled "Unit price" shows exactly "$12.50", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)
field labelled "Total" shows exactly "$12.50", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)

steps.action: Select the calibrator set and enter quantity 3.
steps.expected_text: The full product name is readable, the stock badge reads "Low stock", total is $569.97.
actions: choose "Extended-range calibrator set for high-throughput analyzers" in field labelled "Product"

assertions.expected: field labelled "Selected product" shows exactly "Extended-range calibrator set for high-throughput analyzers", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)
assertions.actual: shows "Extended-range calibrator set for high-throughput analyzers", display: text is cut off horizontally (463px of content in 360px)

assertions.expected: field labelled "Stock status" shows exactly "Low stock", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)
assertions.actual: shows "Low stock", display: is covered by <div#promo>

assertions.expected: field labelled "Unit price" shows exactly "$189.99", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)
field labelled "Total" shows exactly "$569.97", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)

steps.action: Edge case, lower boundary: enter quantity 1.

assertions.expected: alert shows exactly ""
assertions.display_check: off: the error area is empty when there is no error

assertions.expected: button "Place order" is enabled
field labelled "Total" shows exactly "$189.99", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)

steps.action: Edge case, upper boundary: enter quantity 99.

assertions.expected: button "Place order" is enabled
field labelled "Total" shows exactly "$18809.01", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)

steps.action: Edge case, below range: enter quantity 0.

assertions.expected: alert shows exactly "Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 99", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)
button "Place order" is disabled
field labelled "Total" shows exactly "—", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)

steps.action: Edge case, above range: enter quantity 100.

assertions.expected: alert shows exactly "Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 99", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)
assertions.actual: shows "Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 99", displayed intact

assertions.expected: button "Place order" is disabled

steps.action: Edge case, not a number: enter "abc".

assertions.expected: alert shows exactly "Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 99", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)
assertions.actual: shows "Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 99", displayed intact

assertions.expected: button "Place order" is disabled
alert shows exactly "Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 99", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)
assertions.actual: shows "Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 99", displayed intact

assertions.expected: button "Place order" is disabled

steps.action: Edge case, empty: clear the field.

assertions.expected: alert shows exactly "Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 99", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)
assertions.actual: shows "Quantity must be a whole number from 1 to 99", displayed intact

assertions.expected: button "Place order" is disabled

steps.action: Enter quantity 2 and place the order.

assertions.expected: field labelled "Order confirmation" shows exactly "Order placed: 2 × Extended-range calibrator set for high-throughput analyzers", and is displayed intact (in view, not covered, not truncated)
assertions.actual: shows "Order placed: 2 × Extended-range calibrator set for high-throughput analyzers", displayed intact
